verse.verse_1: I CALL TO WITNESS those who dive and drag,
verse.verse_2: And those who undo the bonds gently,
verse.verse_6: The day the convulsive (first blast) shatters convulsively
verse.verse_8: Hearts will pound loudly on that day,
verse.verse_10: They say: "Shall we go back to our original state
verse.verse_11: After having turned to carious bones?"
verse.verse_12: They say: "Then this returning will be a dead loss."
verse.verse_13: It will only be a single blast,
verse.verse_14: And they will wake up suddenly.
verse.verse_15: Has the story of Moses come to you
verse.verse_16: When his Lord called to him in Tuwa's holy vale?
verse.verse_17: "Go to the Pharaoh who has become refractory,
verse.verse_18: And say: 'Would you like to grow (in virtue)?
verse.verse_19: Then I will guide you to your Lord that you may come to fear Him.'"
verse.verse_20: So he showed him the greater sign;
verse.verse_24: Saying: "I am alone your lord, the highest of them all."
verse.verse_25: So God seized him for the punishment of the Hereafter and this world.
verse.verse_26: Truly there is a lesson in this for those who fear (the consequences).
verse.verse_27: Are you more difficult to create or the heavens? He built it,
verse.verse_29: Gave darkness to its night, and brightness to its day;
verse.verse_30: And afterwards spread out the earth.
verse.verse_31: He brought out its water and its pastures from it,
verse.verse_33: As convenience for you and your cattle.
verse.verse_35: The day when man remembers all that he had done,
verse.verse_36: And Hell made visible to him who can see,
verse.verse_37: Then he who had been rebellious
verse.verse_38: And who preferred the life of the world,
verse.verse_39: Will surely have Hell for his abode.
verse.verse_40: But he who feared standing before his Lord, and restrained his self from vain desires,
verse.verse_41: Will surely have Paradise for abode.
verse.verse_42: They ask you: "When will the Hour be? When is its time fixed?"
verse.verse_43: What do you have to do with explaining it?
verse.verse_44: The extent of its knowledge goes to your Lord.
verse.verse_45: Your duty is only to warn him who fears it.
verse.verse_46: The day they see it, it will seem they had stayed in the world but only an evening or its turning into dawn.
